purpose: Inventory Phi repositories, classify them without mutation, discover requirement ledgers, and emit scoped repair-job candidates.

inventory.pagination_rule: Continue until the repository source explicitly reports no additional page/cursor. If the connector repeats a page or cannot expose later pages, record inventory_incomplete and do not claim full-estate coverage.
inventory.first_observed_batch_note: Connected GitHub listing exposed 100 unique repositories in the initial batch on 2026-09-28; total estate is expected to be larger and must not be inferred from this batch.

classification.rule: Classification is descriptive only. Never archive, delete, rename, merge, or repurpose a repository during scanning.

requirement_discovery.ambiguity_rule: If more than one canonical owner remains plausible, create a repo-reader investigation job instead of choosing one.

job_candidate.authorization_rule: Any action listed in phi/overnight-orchestrator.json requires_user_authorization remains blocked until explicit authorization.
job_candidate.granularity: One independently verifiable defect or requirement per job. Split unrelated repairs.

priority: shared service regression affecting multiple Phi surfaces
explicit master-red requirement with known owner

www-infinity4/Alien-Radio: Shop Phi implementation currently hosted with radio

output.note: Generated state paths are contracts for the runtime/Monitor implementation; scanner must not fabricate files when it has not actually scanned the source.

scan_complete_requires: each repository classified or unknown with reason
job candidates emitted for unresolved mapped requirements
